stemMd: A 5.00 g sample of a hydrate loses 1.80 g of water on heating to constant mass. What percentage of the original sample mass was water?
explanationMd: Water mass fraction is 1.80/5.00 = 0.36, or 36%. The remaining 3.20 g is 64%, providing a check that the two fractions total 100%.

distractorRationale.a: This uses neither the original mass nor a conserved component correctly.
distractorRationale.c: This divides water mass by dry salt mass instead of original mass.
distractorRationale.d: This is the dry residue percentage.
distractorRationale.e: This fails to divide by the 5.00 g sample mass.
